data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Avasa' meaning 'descend'. The name Aveys signifies the grace of God, bestowed upon an individual. The name Aveys carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Aveys usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The Puranas, a set of ancient Hindu texts, describe a sage named Aveysa or Avasya, who is one of the Saptarishis or Seven Sages. Aveysa is said to have attained immortality through deep meditation and is regarded as a giver of boons. The name Aveysa is believed to have originated from the Sanskrit word 'avas' meaning all and 'isha' meaning lord or ruler.
